free_tier.stated: Six dedicated machines under USD 100, each on a 1 Gbps unmetered port with full root, a dedicated IP and DDoS protection: an Intel Xeon E3-1230 v2 at 4 cores / 8 threads with 16 GB DDR3 and a 1 TB HDD in Los Angeles at USD 24.95 a month recurring; an Intel Xeon L3426 at 4 cores / 8 threads with 16 GB and 2 x 2 TB in Paris at USD 25.72; an i7-4790K at 4 cores / 8 threads with 32 GB and 2 x 1 TB in Dusseldorf at USD 39.95; an E3-1245 v2 with 32 GB DDR4 and 2 x 480 GB SSD in Montreal at USD 54.99; and a Xeon D-1521 with 16 GB, a 512 GB NVMe and 4 x 4 TB in Montreal. The vendor states the recurring price does not jump after the first month.

interface_detail: inferred from the tooling the provider documents; not probed
chaining: A Paris machine at USD 25.72 with a 1 Gbps unmetered port and 4 TB of disk is the cheapest European dedicated entry found, and it pairs with the OVH or Hetzner object storage that charges per byte rather than per port.

limits.value: The 1 Gbps port is the ceiling and the traffic claim is unmetered with no published fair-use rate, so the throttle is discretionary rather than a stated quota.
